'''Bedareux''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was one of the members of the Imperial support team during the [[Conquest of Makeb]], doing so to support his family.
